I build data pipelines and turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [predicts incarceration rates based on social factors](capstone.qmd).

I care about public health, prison reform, ethical and transparent data science, reproducible workflows, and explaining a model to the person
who has to trust it.

**Currently looking for** data analyst or data scientist roles
starting September 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
